FedAvg.source: standard Federated Averaging baseline (no official paper repo); shared hyper-parameters
FedAvg.aggregation: sample-count weighted average of client weights

FedFV.source: https://github.com/WwZzz/easyFL (flgo/algorithm/fedfv.py) -- FedFV as the aggregation rule
FedFV.aggregation: uniform mean of projected/fairness-corrected deltas (official easyFL rule)

FedAPEN.aggregation: uniform mean of shared models; private models stay local
FedAPEN.personalization: deployed model = weight * private + (1 - weight) * shared

PHP-FL.aggregation: uniform mean of uploaded personal global copies + top-p masked update
PHP-FL.personalization: deployed model = weight * private + (1 - weight) * personal_global

Centralized.source: single CNN-2 trained on the fully aggregated training set
